purpose: Convert Isabel decisions into controlled, auditable execution plans without crossing human authority boundaries.
principles: Every action has an owner, preconditions, evidence, expected outcome, and verification step.
Preparation is allowed more freely than commitment.
Consequential external actions require explicit human approval.
No action may silently convert an inference into a fact.
Failed or blocked actions remain visible and resumable.
Plans are idempotent where possible and safe to retry.
All externally visible actions produce an audit residue.

approval: Approval applies only to the exact consequential step shown to the user.
Material changes after approval invalidate that approval and require re-confirmation.
Bundled approvals must display every consequential action in the bundle.
verification: Do not mark a step complete because a request was sent; verify the resulting state when possible.
If verification is unavailable, mark completion as UNVERIFIED rather than confirmed.
failure: Stop dependent steps after a failed prerequisite.
Explain the blocker and the smallest next action needed to continue.
interruption: User interruption pauses execution at a safe boundary.
Never continue an external consequential action after interruption unless approval remains valid and the user did not cancel it.

example_storefront_plan.goal: Resolve RFI-117 fabrication-release uncertainty without creating an unsupported schedule claim.

steps.action: Confirm latest RFI-117 response and linked storefront submittal revision.
steps.verification: Latest revision IDs and timestamps captured.

steps.action: Confirm fabrication-release status and storefront installation date.
preconditions: Current schedule and procurement evidence available
steps.verification: Release status is confirmed or explicitly marked unknown.

steps.action: Prepare PM briefing and draft coordination message based only on confirmed facts.
steps.verification: Draft distinguishes facts, risks, and unknowns.

steps.action: Approve sending the coordination message or changing the external action plan.
steps.verification: Approval event stored with exact payload hash.
